list.item: What are the solutions of the quadratic equation \((x − 4)(x − 5) = 0\)?

solution.para: Enter the solutions of the quadratic equation.

section.para: Use the Desmos graphing tool or technology outside the course.

problem.para: What are the \(x\)-intercepts of the graph?

div.para: Yes, 4 and 5 are the input values that result in an output of 0. When the function \(f(x) = x^2 − 9x + 20\) is graphed, it crosses the \(x\)-axis at \(x=4\) and \(x=5\).

list.item: Marcus states that the zeros of the function of \(f(x) = x^2 − 9x + 20\) are 4 and 5. Do you agree? Be prepared to show your reasoning.

solution.para: Enter your answer and your reasoning.
